facts.value: Entrance exam conducted by the concerned university followed by a personal interview.
Candidates who have completed GATE/ UGC NET/ UGC CSIR/ SLET examination are exempted from the university level entrance exam but must appear for personal interviews.
Students need to have a master’s in biomedical sciences, biomedical engineering, or a relevant science discipline degree with a minimum aggregate of 60% marks from a recognized institute.
